name: @apxm/frontend
description: TypeScript compiler frontend for APXM: records a workflow graph (GraphBuilder, mirroring the Python apxm.proxy.GraphRecorder), emits AIR (.air MLIR-dialect text) via to_air(), and validates workflow-draft.v1 documents. Op tables in src/generated/ are code-generated from crates/machine/ais/generated/op-spec.v1.json (TSF-1).
